# Save the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_36/target_multisource.csv"

import pandas as pd

# Read the source CSV file with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_36/training_0.csv", index_col=0)

# The target schema is a single column 'variable' which contains lists like ['Cases', 'Guinea']
# We need to unpivot the source data columns that start with 'Cases_' or 'Deaths_' into this format

# Select columns that start with 'Cases_' or 'Deaths_'
cases_cols = [col for col in source0.columns if col.startswith('Cases_')]
deaths_cols = [col for col in source0.columns if col.startswith('Deaths_')]

# Melt cases columns
cases_melted = source0.melt(id_vars=['Date', 'Day'], value_vars=cases_cols, var_name='variable', value_name='value')
# Melt deaths columns
deaths_melted = source0.melt(id_vars=['Date', 'Day'], value_vars=deaths_cols, var_name='variable', value_name='value')

# Combine melted data
combined = pd.concat([cases_melted, deaths_melted], ignore_index=True)

# Drop rows with NaN in 'value' to avoid empty entries
combined = combined.dropna(subset=['value'])

# Split 'variable' column into ['Cases' or 'Deaths', country]
combined['variable'] = combined['variable'].str.split('_')

# Select only the 'variable' column as per target schema
result = combined[['variable']]

# Write to the target CSV file without index
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_36/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
